text_block_list.text:
Between the sloped track and the
3,200-meter
distance, Мэйсё Дото falls
short against T.M.
Opera O.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The rest of the year will be just as long
and
difficult a journey as today, though.
Doto
desperately resolves to follow
Opera O through
to the end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
